musk-wave.desc: striped wavy musk lines curling up

chick-fluff.desc: striped fluff balls waddling, three-toe prints behind

spine-fish.desc: tiny silver fish with three back spines swimming as a shoal

squeal.desc: three-ray squeal marks bouncing, trotter prints behind

flea-hop.desc: specks springing in high arcs, puffs where they land

glow-thread.desc: silk threads hanging off the edge with glowing beads

grub-lamp.desc: pale segmented grubs wriggling, a green lamp at the tail

spider-leap.desc: two big front eyes pouncing in arcs on a silk dragline

fury-tuft.desc: fur tufts trembling with anger, angry marks popping

toe-pad.desc: four-pad toe prints slapping down, a tongue flicks out

centipede-legs.desc: a comb of fine legs rippling as it races along

sand-swim.desc: sand-wave arcs moving like something swims beneath, a gold glint

mud-flop.desc: mud splats flopping up and down

eel-sway.desc: thin eels rising out of the edge and swaying in a row

paw-tumble.desc: pad-and-toe prints tumbling over each other

blue-ring.desc: bright rings with a dark core flashing on and off, ink blot

ink-cloud.desc: round ink puffs blooming from small to large

shell-click.desc: three kinds of shell shuffling in a queue, click marks

glass-glint.desc: hollow outlines only, a light glint crossing them

flipper-track.desc: paired flipper marks scrambling along under a moon glint

urchin-spine.desc: dense radial spines growing and shrinking

leaf-stitch.desc: cross-stitches walked along by green ants, a silk line joins them

bunting-flurry.desc: white and tawny feathers whirling with snow

grouse-whirr.desc: curved wing arcs bursting outward with a whirr

devil-spike.desc: rust spikes with dew beads running along the grooves

stoat-loop.desc: spiralling loop dance, a black tail tip following

cockle-fan.desc: ridged fan shells clapping, squirt jets

shell-dome.desc: plated domes trundling slowly, legs stepping

vole-tunnel.desc: tunnel mounds with a vole head popping up

squelch.desc: slow wet raise, squash on landing that recovers through the wiggle, slime puddle spreads

hop.desc: double hop on the way up, a small re-bounce after the click, dust puffs

thud.desc: fast heavy raise, squash and a 1 px shake on landing, dust

flutter.desc: slow floating raise with side sway, soft landing, two powder motes fall

skitter.desc: quick raise with a tiny side jitter, leg ticks at the sides

scuttle.desc: slides in sideways like a crab, sand dots behind

glide.desc: low slide in from the left, almost no lift, a streak behind

plop.desc: drops from higher, squash, a ring splashes out at the base

bob.desc: bobs on the way up as if floating, a ripple ring on landing

tumble.desc: rolls in (a rotation unwinds during the raise), dust arc

march.desc: steps up in 2 px steps, crumbs at the base

swarm.desc: dots converge onto the spot and the piece fades in out of them

pounce.desc: crouch, then a high quick leap, speed lines below

burrow.desc: rises up out of the ground (comes from below), a dirt mound kicks out

hover.desc: hangs above longer with a small bob and a stipple shadow, then drops

trundle.desc: very slow heavy raise, deep squash, dust

layouts.lance: shoot along the edge in one line
layouts.fall: drop off the edge and fall
layouts.hold: line up along the edge and hold
